== Notes ==
* Can be used in conjuction with [[Breath of the Great Dwarf]] to counter [[burning]] caused by environmental effects, especially in [[A Time for Heroes]], on the [[Ring of Fire Islands]], or during [[Dasha Vestibule]].

{{Anomaly|Heroes only use Extinguish on allies within their [[aggro]] circle, even though the skill works within [[compass]] range.}}

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
